facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports that Ethio telecom has moved from planning into active deployment of the Horizon Fiber corridor linking Djibouti, Ethiopia, Sudan and Jeddah, with end-to-end architecture finalised and site-material procurement and delivery complete so physical deployment can proceed.
The document states a memorandum of understanding for Horizon Fiber was signed in Addis Ababa on 3 December 2024 and a binding agreement followed on 4 February 2026.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom with Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel
